text:
Sam (CEO): Quick weekly — three things: EU Private GA launch readiness (final compliance checklist), SLA targets & rollback plan, and data retention alignment. Short sync Tues 10a PT. :rocket:
Leah (VP Product): Thanks Sam. Docs mostly done, waiting on legal sign-off for DPA changes. I posted the checklist: https://redwood.internal/docs/eu-private-ga-checklist
Sanjay (VP Eng): Eng is green on throughput, but saw a ~5% timeout spike at p95/p99 during long-sequence runs. Suspect prefetch throttling + KV cache pressure. Working on a patch; aiming for canary tonight. @eng-sre please watch.
eng-sre: noted — will create alert and monitor the canary. added runbook link: `#/runbooks/eu-ga-timeouts`
Maria (Head of Ops): Ops needs the SLA numbers we plan to commit publicly, and a rollback playbook. Also confirm who owns incident comms for GA window.
Kate (Finance): Feeding numbers into the sheet now — expected reserved-capacity delta ~+12% infra cost for EU nodes. Sharing link: https://sheets.redwood/ga-costs (will flag assumptions)
Sam (CEO): Keep asks tight. Proposed SLA: 99.9% availability, 150ms median latency for hosted fallbacks, and explicit fallback model list for degraded modes. Approve or suggest tweaks.
Leah (VP Product): That SLA looks reasonable. I'll draft the fallback model list and include in the public GA notes. cc @security for data flow sign-off.
security: Need confirmation on KMS rotation cadence and that audit logs include model invocation metadata. Legal also flagged cross-border transfer language.
Legal: We're on DPA updates. ETA EOD Monday for language on cross-border transfers and customer obligations.
ops-bot: Canary deployment started: `eu-private-ga-canary v1.3.2` -> 3 nodes. Monitoring: https://monitoring.redwood/canaries/5234567890
Sanjay (VP Eng): Rolling patch to reduce prefetch concurrency in canary. If metrics look stable we'll expand to 20% by tomorrow morning PT. Please watch p95/p99 and error budget burn.
Leah (VP Product): Confirming Tuesday 10a sync agenda: compliance sign-off, SLA commit, canary readout, go/no-go decision. Bring any unresolved blockers.
Sam (CEO): Thanks everyone — short and aligned. If you can't make the sync, drop quick notes here or DM me. :thumbsup:
